preparation_charge_interpretation: Conservative 15-minute allowance for measured profiling and acceptance work; not an exact wall-time measurement.
estimate_caveat: Extrapolated from measured pilot and full-training reference fits. Selected model size, convergence repairs, and synchronization exclusions can materially change cost. Finite caps remain authoritative.
deferred_robustness: Contiguous-site track starts only after main work; all already consumed worker and elapsed time is charged to the same global caps.
incomplete_policy: Keep unfinished candidates pending; promote only fully qualified complete candidate results. A partial-roster selection must be labeled explicitly. Do not extend the budget silently.
